planned_arguments.prompt:
Edit the supplied own photographic poster into one complete flat opaque landscape 16:9 poster.

Observed repair: at 720-pixel-wide display, the middle explanation and especially the right-hand access, care, invitation and URL are too small for comfortable continuous reading. Enlarge the explanation's actual glyph bodies by about one third and the lower visit continuation by roughly one half, with clear medium-weight sans strokes and normal leading. Reallocate continuous space for these entries instead of squeezing the enlarged text into the old footprint. All useful visit information must read at a comparable comfortable body size, around 15–16 pixels in the assumed 720-wide view. This is a design assumption, not a required pixel output size.

Keep the successful unequal photographic encounter: descending small pots at the lower left, a closer leaf-petiole-stem-pot attachment near the middle, enveloping mature canopy crossing the upper right. Preserve botanical specificity, naturally attached stems, visible soil, porcelain/terracotta surfaces, believable daylight and crisp leaf/rim edges. Tighten the upper canopy crop and reduce the adjustable title scale moderately if needed to make a broad continuous text seam; keep photos substantial. Put the two-line serif title beside the lower-left pot row as the primary verbal anchor, compact Latin companion directly on its axis. Do not let the companion compete. From this anchor the image edge leads upward into the slogan and explanation; from the paragraph's last line the nearest next start is the right-hand market group at the crop edge. Continue date, hours, place, access/care, invitation and URL together rather than distributing them in corners. Keep the range dashes optically extended at midline and all meaningful word spaces intact.

The explanation may use five short semantic lines to support the larger body, all in one stable upright left-aligned paragraph. Set this unchanged entry exactly once:
작은 화분부터 오래 키운
나무까지 만납니다. 재배자의 이야기를 듣고,
우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는
식물을 골라보세요.

These displayed line choices are flexible design choices: preserve the full sentence, word boundaries and punctuation; favor comfortable body size and continuous reading. Keep the slogan nearby above it. The market name or care sentence may wrap at word boundaries if required to maintain the enlarged reading size. Preserve every existing one of the twelve copy entries, exactly once, including the title's word groups, Korean/Latin letters, date, hours, punctuation and URL; do not add any text. Maintain cool natural greens, charcoal planar type and clean pale highlights. Keep the reading route through active image boundaries, not a passive solid/near-solid/split-field headline/date/information template with subordinate imagery, texture/font substitution or empty-room dressing. No logo, QR, watermark, tags, labels, incidental lettering, new copy, mockup, comparison panels or additional poster.

Output one finished opaque poster in 16:9. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력
